source.title: Nepal rescuers blast hillside in search of hydropower workers as families wait anxiously
source.summary: Rescuers have resorted to explosives as they struggle to reach trapped workers, as the flooding death toll reaches 939.

lesson.title: A difficult rescue in Nepal
lesson.overview: Read about an effort to reach trapped workers.
lesson.topic: Rescue and flooding · mentions people in danger
lesson.prediction: Read the title. What do you think the story is about?
discussion: What happened? Start with: The report says ___.
Imagine you are waiting for important news. Complete: I can ask ___.
news_brief_sentences: Rescuers in Nepal are trying to reach trapped workers.
The workers were at a hydropower site.

vocabulary.definition: people who try to bring others to safety

grammar.explanation: Are waiting describes an activity in progress. It does not tell us when the wait will end.

quiz.question: What are the rescuers trying to do?
options: Move families into a new town
option_feedback: The report describes an effort to reach the workers.
A new power station is not the rescue goal stated here.
This is not the goal described in the report.

quiz.question: What have the rescuers used?
option_feedback: The report says they have used explosives.
The report does not mention a new railway.
The report does not mention a passenger ferry.

quiz.question: What does trapped mean here?
option_feedback: Trapped describes people who cannot get out.
This does not express being unable to escape.
Trapped does not mean waiting for a ticket.

quiz.question: Which sentence describes waiting in progress?
options: The families will wait next month.
option_feedback: Are waiting describes an activity in progress.
Waited last year places the activity in the past.
Will wait next month describes a future activity.
